tldr: Mars in the 3rd house routes drive and action through voice and daily mind.
body: With Mars in the 3rd house, drive, assertion, desire, conflict, courage, heat, and the ability to act move through communication, learning, siblings, neighbors, and daily movement. This makes how you speak, study, write, listen, and move through the immediate world a central part of the life. Used consciously, this placement can become initiative, courage, stamina, directness, and the power to move this area forward. Left unconscious, it can become impatience, defensiveness, conflict for its own sake, or burning through this area faster than it can stabilize.
gift: initiative, courage, stamina, directness, and the power to move this area forward expressed through voice and daily mind.
challenge: impatience, defensiveness, conflict for its own sake, or burning through this area faster than it can stabilize concentrated in voice and daily mind.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-house material; source file was not copied into the repository.
